# Fleet

Goal: Give every recurring job a specialist and a fallback chain that survives any single usage wall.
Success means: Each job runs on its primary rung, and at a wall the orchestrator names the next eligible rung on another pool.
Stop when: The job is done, or every rung is walled or ineligible and Emilio has been asked.

Pick the first rung that passes all four checks; otherwise checkpoint and ask Emilio. Where a job names two peers (Fable and Astra reviewing, Sonnet and Gemini exploring), alternate them by round and record the last one in PROGRAM-LOG.md.

1. Its pool is below 100%. Nothing switches on its own: at a wall the orchestrator checkpoints, names the next rung, and waits for Emilio's one-word answer.
2. Its family did not write or revise the work it would verify or review.
3. On a repo that holds PHI (Cooper first), it is not Muse.
4. It can do the job: Gemini rungs edit but cannot commit, run tests, or reach the network, so Muse runs the floor and the orchestrator commits their diff.

`ask` means no verified rung is left: checkpoint and ask Emilio.

## Jobs

| Job | Primary | Fallback 1 | Fallback 2 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Orchestration | `opus` | `opus-b` | `opus-cursor` | Same model on three pools, so kickoffs carry over unchanged. |
| Plans and specs | `opus` | `opus-b` | `opus-cursor` | Design synthesis stays on Opus; Fable or Astra checks it before any lane spawns. |
| Plan check and draft revision | `fable` | `astra-ro` | `grok` | Never the plan's author; Astra read-only hallucinates least. |
| Frontend | `sol` | `opus-fe` | `sol-cursor` | Emilio's 2026-09-29 ruling: Sol at xhigh implements frontend; Opus is the runner-up on another pool. |
| Backend and tests | `sol` | `opus-b` | `sol-cursor` | Sol at xhigh; Opus is the benchmarked runner-up; Cursor keeps a Sol model on another pool. |
| Verification | `fable` | `astra-ro` | `muse` | Fable and Astra alternate by round: the one that did not review last round goes first, and the host reruns every command behind a PASS. |
| Verification on PHI repos | `grok-host` | `astra-ro` | `opus-b` | Muse never sees PHI; skip whichever family wrote the lane. |
| Diff review | `fable` | `astra-ro` | `grok` | Fable and Astra alternate by round; Sol writes the code, so both are another family. |
| Exploration, search and investigation | `sonnet` | `gemini-explore` | `grok` | Sonnet at high leads and Gemini rotates in for 1M-token reads; Grok Ultra is the third pool. |
| Minor code changes | `sonnet` | `sonnet-b` | `bench` | A fence of one to three files with a named test; wider or contract-changing work goes to Opus or Sol by domain. |
| Second opinion and spare hands | `gemini-explore` | `sonnet` | `grok` | Gemini rotates in as the extra reader; Sonnet and Grok sit on other pools. |
| Bulk edits | `gemini` | `bench` | `grok-host` | Mechanical sweeps; Muse verifies and the orchestrator commits. |
| Doc writing | `gemini` | `sonnet-b` | `bench` | Emilio's ruling; give Gemini an explicit length cap (it ran 66% over one in review). |
| Computer use | `astra` | `opus-b` | `ask` | Opus with Claude in Chrome covers browser walks only; no verified desktop route beyond Astra. |
| Browser QA | `astra` | `opus-b` | `ask` | Grok cannot run Chromium; Opus never checks Opus-written frontend. |
| Web research | `grok-host` | `opus-b` | `grok-cursor` | Grok leads research benches; headless Gemini has no network. |
| CI and PR triage | `grok-cursor` | `grok` | `bench` | Puts the idle Cursor cheap pool to work; diagnose and fix locally, never push. |
| Overflow, whole chain walled | `ask` | `opus-cursor` | `m3` | Cursor bills at API rate; claude-m3 takes mechanical work only. |

## Pools

| Pool | What draws on it |
|---|---|
| A | Claude Max, elioai.app: Opus, Sonnet and Fable (Fable capped at 50%), both CLI seats |
| B | Claude Max, second account: overflow |
| X | Codex on ChatGPT Pro: Sol, Astra and Luna share one pool |
| G | Google AI Pro: Gemini through agy |
| K | Grok Ultra |
| M | Muse Power, contributor tier (may train on usage) |
| C | Cursor Ultra: Grok and Composer in the cheap pool, everything else billed at API rate |
| L | Local: claude-m3, no quota |
